title: MR-01 — Reconcile humanoid-motion architecture with current code and evidence
objective: Reconcile current humanoid-motion guidance with verified source consumers and identity-bound evidence, preserving clinical and protected-policy boundaries, and produce reviewed conditional comparison and implementation release criteria.
body:
## read_closure: Read AGENTS/PROJECT_STATUS, board-conduit, chief-coordinator/XR/asset role guidance; motion architecture brief (historical clinical ledger), ENTRYPOINT/full design/DSL consumer note; motion-compiler, xr-humanoid-animation, asset-registry and their live production consumers in ui-xr, Model Vetting, factory-stations/shared-schemas and admin package boundary; retained bake-off report/harness/descriptors/capture/tests, seated postprocessor/source provenance and clip inventory; scene-closure frozen requirements and SC05/07 evidence; public-surface/package architecture guardrails. Use symbol search and configured LSP to discover actual transitive read closure. These are reads, not write exclusions. Read source assets for hashes without modifying or committing generated binaries.

## deliverables
Owner ingestion prerequisite: Idle until owner commits handoff, supplied portable planted test and honest baseline ledger/proposal/manifest seeds on main, reviews their meaningfulness and records ingestion revision. Control must demonstrate actual unsupported/stale guidance with all required files present, never an absent-file/import RED. Read complete immutable card contract; if observations invalidate it, owner recreates/cancels rather than commenting amendments. No dispatch now.

Program staging: This is a reconciliation child of motion-program pointer tsk_e8ac84dd9cb6ac06. The pointer remains non-executable. This contract controls MR-01; it does not release old motion children. MR-02/MR-03 are conditional handoff specifications, not placeholder cards.

Required deliverables: Follow MR-01 in the committed handoff: current decision-ledger.md/json with all minimum topics and nine historical open decisions; comparison-proposal.md with per-job required decisions and conditional release; delegation-manifest.json binding sources, output identities, test outcomes and independent semantic review. Correct only factual state/links in ENTRYPOINT under the handoff’s limited preparation approval; keep full design read-only and do not reclassify registry authority. Entrypoint/full design/old brief are archive-candidate/no instruction weight in current registry; preserve historical rejection context without promoting it. Current ENTRYPOINT must explicitly state registry precedence, including over “Read this first” and historical AUTHORITATIVE wording; retained quotes are historical context. Preserve supersession rejection basis and qualify historical negative evidence.

Proof and independent owner acceptance: Use the supplied planted test committed at ingestion, paired with live: and actual Vitest execution. Its non-vacuity guard requires all referenced files before measuring the genuine current-instruction contradiction. Fixed clauses validate limited current guidance/input classification and structured ledger coverage; they do not prove visual quality or clinical validity. No verifier framework is invented at dispatch. Preserve diagnosis and failing controls; flip raw it.fails to it only after correction. Owner independently grades consequential claims against current code/production consumers and resolves authority/release decisions after worker returns review. Worker leaves owner-acceptance clause (7) planted and manifest review pending. Owner cross-checks actual worker session ID with the board and reviewer session ID with the independent reviewer’s retained CLI/session output, requires distinct reviewer, claim-by-claim review record and accepted final output hashes, then flips clause (7), runs full suite/live and only then proofs.set. A seed string or pending review is not landable. A worker-authored review artifact cannot replace that independent review. Historical actor digest failure is classified evidence, not a required green capture.

Named failed-treatment facts (must not be retried as a false fix):
- Historical bake-off: neither requested clutch succeeded; runtime pulse descriptor lacked a pulse goal. Verdict other cannot justify an architecture winner.
- Digest repair previously recaptured but a later actor rebake made actor identity stale again. Editing hashes alone would falsely bind retained images to new inputs.
- Keyword/existence/source inspection alone cannot establish semantic reconciliation; independent claim-to-consumer review is required.
knownGood: `tools/openclinxr/evidence/humanoid-motion/clip-channel-deviation.ts` and its report demonstrate a committed inventory instrument; `tools/openclinxr/evidence/motion-backend-bakeoff/the-bakeoff-report-digests-match-the-files-on-disk.test.ts:63` provides input-presence/digest-field vacuity guards; clause (1) at line 74 currently fails and diagnoses input identity drift. These references prove limited inventory/input checks, not motion quality. Follow `docs/openclinxr/humanoid-motion-reassessment-2026-09-13/handoff.md` committed at ingestion.
outOfScope: No motion implementation, recapture, clinical schema, touch policy, frozen scene closure, live floor/SC07 changes or public marketing.
notTested: New captures, current anatomy/contact quality, M1 model execution, clinical validation and Quest evidence.
